A vet mentioned in an AskVoat discussion when he was deployed to Afganistan or Iraq they would get care packages from charities of stuff they didn't need. It gave me the idea of setting up a subverse where deployed folks could publish wish lists and people like me could buy stuff off it. I'm trying to get it off the ground.
